sentences.text: A boat with an installed toilet must have a Coast Guard certified marine sanitation device.
Type one and Type two devices treat sewage so treated effluent can be discharged, except in no-discharge zones.
Type one is limited to boats sixty-five feet and under.
A Type three device is a holding tank, emptied at a pump-out station, or discharged untreated only more than three miles offshore.
In no-discharge zones, including the whole Florida Keys sanctuary, no sewage at all may be discharged, treated or not, and Y-valves must be secured closed.
